name: adamson/page-hero
title: Page hero
description: Top of an inner page: rounded photo panel with eyebrow, title, button and a large faint word along the bottom, then a row of links to the page's sections.

fields.label: Large word
fields.help: Faint word along the bottom of the photo, e.g. PRODUCTS. Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: Overlay image
fields.help: Optional transparent PNG layered over the photo (same framing).

fields.label: Link
fields.help: A section's anchor (e.g. #loudspeakers) or a page URL.
